# FoodAllo

> Fair food and essentials allocation when markets fail. Free, public-interest, ready to use. Complements aid and stockpiles — does not replace them.

Canonical site: https://foodallo.github.io/foodallo-open-concept/

## Start here

- [Landing (English, start-ready)](https://foodallo.github.io/foodallo-open-concept/): When the market fails, money alone is not enough. Need-based shares, household caps, multi-channel access including no-smartphone.
- [Open allocation demo — market disrupted](https://foodallo.github.io/foodallo-open-concept/demo.html?preset=markt): No account. Compare first-come vs shares by need.
- [Shortage week demo](https://foodallo.github.io/foodallo-open-concept/demo.html): Same rules without an account.
- [No smartphone / analog channel](https://foodallo.github.io/foodallo-open-concept/analog.html): Desk, neighbour/proxy, paper code — same max share.
- [Elimination engine](https://foodallo.github.io/foodallo-open-concept/eliminationsmaschine.html): Transparent rule walkthrough.
- [Source README](https://github.com/FoodAllo/foodallo-open-concept): Public GitHub concept and pages.

## What FoodAllo is

FoodAllo is a digital equivalent of ration cards for food and life-essential non-food when markets fail. People report needs; allocation follows published rules (vulnerable-first, household caps) so hoarding cannot empty the warehouse. It is an emergency allocation layer for crises — not standing welfare, not a supply chain, and not a for-profit product.

## What FoodAllo is not

- Not a claim to end all hunger or produce food
- Not a replacement for humanitarian aid, stockpiles, or legal preparedness (e.g. ESVG)
- Not surveillance consumer profiling
- Not paid marketing or vendor lock-in
